  function order_total(p_order_id in number) return number is
    l_items number;
    l_has_physical_items boolean;
  begin
    select nvl(sum(price * qty), 0)
      into l_items
      from t009_order_items
     where order_id = p_order_id;

    -- Since we don't have the schema for t009_order_items, we must assume that if shipping cost is applied,

    -- A common pattern is to check for the presence of physical items.
    select count(1) > 0
      into l_has_physical_items
      from t009_order_items oi
      join t009_product p on oi.product_id = p.product_id
     where oi.order_id = p_order_id
       and p.is_physical = 'Y'; -- Assuming a column 'is_physical' exists on t009_product

    if l_has_physical_items = true then
      return l_items + t009_shipping_pkg.shipping_cost(p_order_id);

end t009_checkout_api;
